# awscc_osis_pipeline_endpoint (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::OSIS::PipelineEndpoint



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline endpoint.
- `endpoint_id` (String) The unique identifier of the pipeline endpoint.
- `ingest_endpoint_url` (String) The URL used to ingest data to the pipeline through the VPC endpoint.
- `pipeline_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline to create the endpoint for.
- `status` (String) The current status of the pipeline endpoint.
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC where the pipeline endpoint was created.
- `vpc_options` (Attributes) Configuration settings for the VPC endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc_options))

<a id="nestedatt--vpc_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpc_options`

Read-Only:

- `security_group_ids` (List of String) A list of security group IDs that control network access to the pipeline endpoint.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) A list of subnet IDs where the pipeline endpoint network interfaces are created.
